title: Learn With Mentor AI: Working Through a Coding Exercise
description: Learn how to use Mentor AI on a Real Python coding exercise. Ask why a test failed, get hints instead of the answer, and check your understanding.
summary: Real Python has hundreds of coding exercises that let you practice what you’ve learned in a tutorial or course. Each exercise gives you a task, a code editor, and a set of tests that check your solution.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Learn With Mentor AI: Working Through a Coding Exercise Practice getting unstuck on a Python coding exercise with Mentor AI, from mutable default arguments to checking for None with is.

Prerequisites To follow along with this tutorial, you’ll need the following: A Real Python membership with Mentor AI access: The exercise you’ll use is part of a members-only course, and you need to be signed in to use Mentor AI.
You’ll work on the Fix the Sticky Default List exercise from the Python’s None: Null in Python course.
